evidence: 0x0059B057-0x0059B06C: edx = ds:0x9a64e8 & 0xff, and-tested with 1 << faction_id to gate the visibility exemption, and the surviving edx drives the penalty
0x0059B99C-0x0059B9A3 (reconstruction copy): neg edx / sbb edx,edx / and edx,0xffffff9d / add edx,0x64 yields 1 when edx was nonzero (human) and 100 otherwise
0x0059B0EF-0x0059B103: xor edx,edx / setle dl / dec edx / and edx,0x5dc / add edx,0x3e8 on ds:0x9a6800 (SunspotDuration) yields 2500 while it is positive and 1000 once it runs out
payload.hypothesis: The truce-ground penalty in find's treaty block is is_human(faction_id) ? 1 : 100, selected via LockEnableMask byte 0 (0x009A64E8) exactly as is_human()/factions_status_byte() read it, while treaty ground costs SunspotDuration > 0 ? 2500 : 1000; zoc_path's own is_human gate reads the same byte, tying both spellings to that global.
